paper_metadata.title: SOCIOECONOMIC STATUS AND LIFESTYLE IN YOUNG ISCHAEMIC STROKE PATIENTS: A POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP TO STROKE RECOVERY AND RISK OF RECURRENT EVENT

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study used a prospective, consecutive recruitment strategy within a defined age group (<50 years) at a comprehensive stroke center. Baseline characteristics are well-defined, and the sampling frame is clear.
